# Load data

```{r}
CH4 <- read_excel("../Data/seasonal_total_CH4.xlsx", sheet = 1)
N2O <- read_excel("../Data/seasonal_total_N2O.xlsx", sheet = 1)


Combined <- N2O %>%
  left_join(
    CH4 %>%
      select(plot_number, total_CH4_emissions_kg_ha),
    by = "plot_number"
  )

Combined$GWP <- Combined$total_CH4_emissions_kg_ha*34+ Combined$total_N2O_emissions_kg_ha*298

```

# Initial stats

## GWP

```{r}
model <- lm(GWP~Treatment, data=Combined%>%filter(Treatment !="LD-MS"))

pls205_diagnostics(model)
            
anova(model)

Treatment_means = emmeans(model,spec = 'Treatment')
Treatment_effects = contrast(Treatment_means, method = 'pairwise', adjust = "tukey")
summary(Treatment_effects)
cld(Treatment_means)
```
